body.name: paired-splice soft-loss frontier handle
body.construction: Tensorize two-arm Hall splices across paired cells at an arbitrary admissible amplitude, retain the exact logarithmic mixture loss, condition on the pair sample counts, factor the product posterior, and compare every feasible zero/one/two-cell capacity allocation with one posterior-MAP action per pair by concavity. A binomial lower-tail calculation followed by amplitude optimization gives the multiscale same-class lower envelope. The coordinatewise sorting-and-inversion learner remains a separate upper witness; equality of the two bounds is not part of this construction.
